review_scope: Minimal independent static review of deployment and once-only CPU launch helpers; no remote/GPU actions or wrapper changes
positive_checks: Deployment verifies origin branch SHA equals local commit and checks exact reviewed wrapper SHA8cc378 before transferring only wrapper/reviews/README; source working tree was clean during local review.
SSH routing defaults to exact retained h100-10 management route with pinned target identity; no model/data transfer, training or foreign-task action.
Remote Python template token substitution yields syntactically valid code; outer shell quoting roundtrips exact Python source and inner shell uses shlex.join/quote for arguments/log destination.

Launcher gates owned evaluation unit inactive/MainPID0/ExecMainStatus0, actual COMPLETE/workerexit0/cleanup{} and full51713 metrics before creating CPU submission intent. Wrapper retains stronger identity/evidence gates before model load.

cpu-dispatch-once.json uses exclusive create and fsync before one systemd-run; prior intent or existing acceptance namespace refuses duplicates. Ambiguous/failure outcomes retain intent; launch stdout/stderr/returncode are saved separately.
Own CPU service uses8CPU quota/96G memory bound/7200s maximum, explicitly hiddenCUDA and unoptimized offline isolated Python. No GPU allocation, original evaluator modifications or cancellation.
CPU wrapper log remains in retained run inputs; failed wrapper preserves its namespace/log and helpers do not automatically retry or overwrite.
limits: Acceptance is helper source scope only. Mainline must inspect actual deployment result and service progression/exit; submission result is not actual full-HF acceptance.
Any deployment or launch timeout/partial failure requires inspection of persistent path/intent/service evidence, never blind retry.
